views.evidence:
# Can we repeat the Lumen board claims?

**For Mosaic Studio, as of fictional November 6: use USD80/hour only within
Lumen's October–December production retainer; report a calculated 62.5% October
project-review margin; describe the mockup as approved and the launch as awaiting
acceptance. Review the conditional November 20 launch reservation with Bea.**

## “Our standard rate is now USD80/hour”

**Answer:** The supplied terms support USD80/hour for Lumen's retainer production,
with work outside it separately quoted. The listed Studio ad-hoc rate remains
USD120/hour. They do not establish a blanket rate change.

**Why:** The [retainer copy](sources/contracts/06-lumen.txt) says “Production hours
billed USD 80/hour within this retainer.” The [rate sheet](sources/docs/02-rate-card.md)
lists USD120/hour. The [supplied owner confirmation](sources/owner/definitions-and-authority.md#commercial)
confirms the scoped October–December exception and preserves the ad-hoc rate.
The [forwarded conversation](sources/chat/07-exception.txt) also keeps ad-hoc at
the rate sheet; its original chat server is unavailable. Owner confirmation is
supplied fictional evidence, not independent authentication of that server.

## “The redesign gives us 85% margin”

**Answer:** October Lumen's project-review margin calculates to **62.5%**, under
the supplied company definition. This does not measure redesign causation or net profit.

**Why:** The [reconciled ledger](sources/tables/ledger-reconciled.csv), MS/Lumen/2026-10
row, records USD4,000 recognized fees and USD1,500 posted direct cost:
`(4,000 − 1,500) / 4,000 = 62.5%`.
The [owner definition](sources/owner/definitions-and-authority.md#metric) excludes
sales tax and unposted owner-time estimates. [Invoice I-71](sources/tables/10-invoices.csv)
is USD4,500 gross including USD500 tax; it is issued, not recorded as collected.
The Expansion invoice is a draft. Neither changes this calculation's denominator.

The [original ledger](sources/tables/09-ledger.csv) recorded USD2,000 cost, implying
50% under the same definition. The [working note](sources/notes/13-close-query.md)
only suspected a duplicate. The [November 2 correction](sources/owner/2026-11-02-correction.md)
records the posted USD500 reversal. This is a reconciliation of October costs,
not a measured redesign benefit. [Interview feedback](sources/notes/18-feedback.md)
contains no profitability study.

## “Lumen is delivered, so November 20 is guaranteed”

**Answer:** B2 mockup approval is established in the supplied client email.
Launch acceptance remains open. November 20 was a conditional reservation, and
the new forecast puts its prerequisite at risk; it does not approve a new deadline.

**Why:** The [October client email](sources/mail/14-client.txt) says “We approve the
B2 design mockup” and explicitly separates final launch acceptance. The
[November 6 client message](sources/mail/2026-11-06-lumen.txt) says “We have not
accepted the launched website.” The [plan](sources/chat/16-plan.txt) reserves
November 20 **if** accessibility review finishes by November 17. The
[QA forecast](sources/qa/2026-11-06.txt) expects review November 23, with possible
four-day remediation. PUB-2 depends on passing AX-7. Tint's PHOTO-8 remains
independent; [moving shifts](sources/ops/2026-11-06-staffing.txt) is a proposal,
not cancellation of Lumen or an amendment to its retainer.

**What remains open:** Bea has [supplied authority for client commitments](sources/owner/definitions-and-authority.md#authority).
Ask for an updated accessibility/publication plan and her decision on the reservation
and customer communication. Review progress, publication and client acceptance
records before calling the launch complete. These are recommended checks, not
actions already performed or permission to contact the customer.

## Why three summaries don't make three confirmations

The [sales statement](sources/chat/03-sales.txt) became the [team note](sources/notes/04-team.md)
and then the [board summary](sources/notes/05-board.md). The
[new sales summary](sources/notes/2026-11-06-summary.md) copies that board summary
without inspecting the finance correction or QA forecast. Preserve that lineage;
repetition adds no independent evidence for the rate, profit or completion claims.
